rows.commentary: 0.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi oversteps his mark immediately, spraying the opening delivery down the leg side for a wide.
0.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi induces a sharp square drive from Brian Bennett that bursts through the point fielder's fingertips for a single.
0.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi drops a low full toss that Innocent Kaia inside-edges past the timber for a boundary.
0.3: Fazalhaq Farooqi tests a standard length, which Innocent Kaia steers down to third man for a comfortable single.
0.4: Fazalhaq Farooqi slides one in fuller, and Brian Bennett drives it on the up to mid-off for one.
0.5: Fazalhaq Farooqi hits the seam, and Innocent Kaia securely stabs the delivery straight to point.
0.6: Fazalhaq Farooqi claims the first wicket as Innocent Kaia pokes tentatively and edges behind to wicketkeeper Noor ul Rahman.
1.1: Azmatullah Omarzai strikes as Brian Bennett drills a fuller delivery straight into the hands of Ibrahim Zadran at mid-off.
1.2: Azmatullah Omarzai beats Ryan Burl on the inside edge with a loose prod away from the body.
1.3: Azmatullah Omarzai targets the pads, allowing Ryan Burl to clip it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
1.4: Azmatullah Omarzai fires a fuller length into the pitch, which Sikandar Raza defensively stabs back to the bowler.
1.5: Azmatullah Omarzai rattles in a hard length around off, safely defended.
10.1: Noor Ahmad darts the googly spraying down the leg side, leaving Tadiwanashe Marumani searching for a connection as it scoots past.
10.1: Tadiwanashe Marumani stays back to a flat delivery outside off, guiding an untimed cut wide of backward point to pinch a single.
10.2: Noor Ahmad unleashes a googly pitching outside off and spinning away, baffling Wessly Madhevere as his attempted reverse-sweep sails into thin air.
10.3: Noor Ahmad outflanks Wessly Madhevere with a full, tossing googly that induces a wild lunge, leaving the batter stranded as Noor ul Rahman whips off the bails for a stumping.

10.4: Noor Ahmad strikes with a length ball from round the wicket that straightens on middle, catching Tafadzwa Tsiga's leading edge for a sharp slip catch by Ibrahim Zadran to trigger two wickets in two balls.
10.5: A single to Newman Nyamhuri off Noor Ahmad.
10.6: Tadiwanashe Marumani succumbs to Noor Ahmad, offering a catch to Azmatullah Omarzai to deepen Zimbabwe's troubles.
11.1: Wide from Abdullah Ahmadzai to Newman Nyamhuri.
11.1: Wide from Abdullah Ahmadzai to Newman Nyamhuri.
11.1: No run for Newman Nyamhuri off Abdullah Ahmadzai.
11.2: Newman Nyamhuri does not score off Abdullah Ahmadzai.
11.3: No-ball from Abdullah Ahmadzai to Newman Nyamhuri.
11.3: Newman Nyamhuri finds the boundary off Abdullah Ahmadzai for four.
11.4: Abdullah Ahmadzai delivers a good length ball which Newman Nyamhuri safely defends back down the track.
11.5: Newman Nyamhuri takes 2 off Abdullah Ahmadzai.
4.3: Masuku pins a good-length delivery onto the stumps, and Sediqullah Atal drops his weight onto the back foot to safely steer it down toward mid-on.
4.4: Masuku strikes as Sediqullah Atal punches a short-of-length ball too early, ballooning a catch straight to Madhevere at backward point.
4.5: Masuku angles a short delivery past the outside edge as Noor ul Rahman slashes wildly and misses completely.
4.6: Masuku traps Noor ul Rahman plumb in front with a straightening length ball, and the umpire rightly raises his finger to seal a silver duck.
5.1: Nyamhuri completely loses his release, spraying one miles wide before Marumani saves the boundary with a sharp dive to his right.
5.1: Azmatullah Omarzai gets firmly forward to a full delivery, stroking it cleanly through the cover region to open his account with a pair.
5.2: Nyamhuri zips a pacy length ball across the right-hander, leaving Azmatullah Omarzai defeated on the outside edge with no foot movement.
5.3: Azmatullah Omarzai rocks back and murders a short ball high over deep point, sending it crashing onto the stadium roof for a massive maximum.
5.4: Nyamhuri delivers a short-of-length ball outside off that Azmatullah Omarzai cuts firmly, only to pick out the fielder at cover-point.
5.5: Azmatullah Omarzai lunges at a full delivery outside off and thumps his drive straight into the hands of the mid-off fielder.
5.6: Nyamhuri rolls his fingers over a clever slower ball on the leg stump, allowing Azmatullah Omarzai to watchfully tuck it toward mid-wicket.
6.1: Masuku drifts one full onto the stumps, and Ibrahim Zadran effortlessly whips it over the infield to race away to the boundary.
6.2: Masuku pitches this full outside off, and Ibrahim Zadran answers with a furious, unstoppable straight drive screaming toward the boundary.
6.3: Masuku fires it in near-yorker length on the leg-stump, allowing Ibrahim Zadran to glance it away toward deep backward square-leg for a single.
6.4: Masuku steams in and Azmatullah Omarzai nudges the delivery away into the mid-on region for a quick run.
6.5: Masuku delivers once more, and Ibrahim Zadran dispatches it all the way to the long-off boundary for four.
7.1: Blessing Muzarabani bangs it in hard on off-stump, forcing Azmatullah Omarzai onto the back foot to fend it safely toward backward point under Ibrahim Zadran's watchful eye.
7.2: Blessing Muzarabani targets the middle stump with another heavy delivery, and Azmatullah Omarzai steps forward to pull it into the mid-wicket pocket for a hard-run couple.

7.3: Blessing Muzarabani finds the outside edge as Azmatullah Omarzai backs away to loft, but Tadiwanashe Marumani makes a dreadful hash of the regulation chance behind the sticks, leaving a furious bowler in despair.
7.4: Blessing Muzarabani delivers a shortish ball outside off, allowing Azmatullah Omarzai to ease onto the back foot and glide it smoothly down to third man for a single.
7.5: Blessing Muzarabani probes the back of a length on middle, tying up Ibrahim Zadran who drops onto his back foot to nudge it securely toward mid-wicket.
7.6: Muzarabani darts this short of a length right into the channel, denying Ibrahim any width as he pushes it back before flashing a sharp left hand to intercept the return.

8.1: Vincent Masekesa drops a half-tracker on middle-stump, and Azmatullah Omarzai emphatically nails it off the back foot, sending the pull soaring into the top-tier of the long-on stands to seal victory.
